service.description:
Generalizes the single hand-made edge in CyberPlcNormCrosswalkDemoSeedData.xml (MqttConnectionFactory.password -> IEC 62443-3-3 SR 1.7 RE 1) into a systematic service: for any moqui-plc-knowledge code graph (PLC/SCL or C, same moqui.math.GraphVertex substrate via the shared PlcGraphVertexMeta view), finds two kinds of real, structurally-detectable findings and crosswalks each to a real, verified norm clause (never invented - looked up dynamically by documentId+ clauseNumber, same convention as every clause vertex already in this project):
1. SecurityObservation vertices (vertexType=SecurityObservation) - already emitted by the real parser (parser/c_firmware_parser.py's C_UNBOUNDED_COPY/ C_PLAINTEXT_NETWORK_SCHEME/C_SHARED_GLOBAL_MULTI_WRITER rules) when the code graph was generated - this service does not detect new patterns, it crosswalks patterns the parser already found. 2. Symbol vertices (vertexType=Symbol, codeKind=Variable) whose canonicalName matches a credential-like name (password/secret/credential/token/apikey) - the same structural signal that produced the one real hand-made edge.
Pattern-to-clause table (verified via search#NormClauses/search#NormClausesSemantic against the real loaded corpus before writing this service, not guessed): C_UNBOUNDED_COPY -> IEC-62443-4-1 8.4.1 (secure coding standards) C_PLAINTEXT_NETWORK_SCHEME -> IEC-62443-4-2 8.2 (confidentiality in transit) credential-like Symbol -> IEC-62443-3-3 5.9.3.1 (SR 1.7 RE 1) C_SHARED_GLOBAL_MULTI_WRITER has no verified norm clause match (a real, honest gap, not forced) - reported as a finding with no crosswalk edge.
Writes crosswalk edges into the existing dedicated CyberPlcNormCrosswalk Graph (never merges the code graph and the norm graph), same pattern as the original hand-made edge. Sixth reuse of math-model-run-tracking.

parameter.name: graphId
parameter.description: The code Graph to scan, e.g. TestIec61131Codesys or IotFirmwareC.
